llm.summary: This is a Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning skill with clear safety and privacy boundaries and no hidden execution behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly designed for mainland China Simplified Chinese K12 chemistry workflows, including China-specific curriculum and safety guidance; deployment elsewhere requires localization.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON files only, with no executable files, install scripts, remote payload retrieval, or dependency installation behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are detailed but purpose-scoped, with explicit limits around exams, experiments, student privacy, crisis handling, and teacher review; no prompt hijacking or unrelated authority was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It reads scoped classroom fields and writes only pending lessonPlans entries for teacher confirmation, with controls for view, correction, deletion, pause, sharing, and export; no automatic or hidden persistence was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s capabilities match its stated purpose: it drafts chemistry lesson plans, review lessons, and lecture plans while deferring lab operations, exam design, grading, parent communication, and other out-of-scope work to separate skills.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning workflows where teachers review outputs before use. Do not deploy it unchanged for other countries or languages; localize curriculum assumptions, crisis hotlines, legal references, and data-consent rules first.
llm.findings:
[AE4] expected: The flagged Unicode/mixed-script content is consistent with Simplified Chinese curriculum text, chemistry notation, and mixed Chinese/English filenames; inspection did not find hidden bidi/control characters or evidence of analysis evasion.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only instructional material is purpose-aligned because the package’s shared platform conventions explicitly state it targets mainland China Chinese K12 use; this is a localization note rather than a security concern.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The SARIF scan reported no T01-T09 results, and artifact inspection found no executable scripts, remote code loading, tool hijacking, privilege escalation, or system persistence.
